description: A Python pickling decompiler and static analyzer

written.description: Decompiles pickle bytecode back into readable Python, and will rewrite or build one too. The same tool that tells you a model file is malicious is the one that shows you how such a file is made.

alive.last_commit_message:
Support Python 3.11 through 3.15 (#331)

Raise Fickling's minimum supported Python version to 3.11 and add Python
3.15 to the test matrix, package metadata, documentation, and tooling
configuration.

Run all Python CI jobs without fail-fast and install strictly from 
the committed lockfile. Source torch and torchvision from PyTorch's
official CPU index because the test suite does not require GPU support
and PyPI does not yet have Python 3.15 wheels.

Introduce a one-week uv dependency cooldown and regenerate 
the lockfile after all these changes.
